name: Adrenaline potion
description: +25% adrenaline. Shares a 120 s cooldown with all adrenaline potions.

name: Super adrenaline potion
description: +30% adrenaline. Shares the 120 s adrenaline potion cooldown.

name: Adrenaline renewal potion
description: +40% adrenaline over 6 seconds. Shares the 120 s adrenaline potion cooldown.

name: Replenishment potion
description: +25% adrenaline plus prayer/summoning restore. Shares the 120 s adrenaline potion cooldown.

name: Enhanced replenishment potion
description: +30% adrenaline plus prayer/summoning restore. Shares the 120 s adrenaline potion cooldown.

name: Vulnerability bomb
description: Throws a 3x3 bomb: the target takes 10% more damage from all sources for 60 seconds. Off the global cooldown, no cooldown.

name: Powerburst of vitality
description: Doubles current and maximum life points for 6 seconds (10 ticks); afterwards the maximum returns and the current life points are capped by it. Off the global cooldown. Shares the 120 s powerburst cooldown with every other powerburst.

name: Powerburst of acceleration
description: Resets the cooldowns of Surge, Dive and Bladed Dive and sets them to 1.2 s (2 ticks) for 6 seconds (10 ticks); Bladed Dive deals no damage meanwhile. Off the global cooldown. Shares the 120 s powerburst cooldown with every other powerburst.

name: Dominion mine
description: Deployed mine: about 5 seconds later it deals 20% of the target's maximum life points (cap 10,000) to a monster of combat level 138 or less. Two mines per minute. Off the global cooldown.

name: Sticky bomb
description: Throws a 3x3 bomb that binds monsters in it for 6 seconds (10 ticks). No damage. Off the global cooldown, no cooldown.
